test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Bacteria are single-celled organisms that can reproduce on its own.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The sentence** "Bacteria are single-celled organisms that can reproduce on its own." contains **an error in the part **"reproduce on its own."
 
• The **correct form should be** "reproduce on their own" because **"bacteria"** is a plural noun.
 
• Using** "its"** for a plural subject creates a subject-pronoun disagreement, which is a** grammatical error.**
 
• **"Bacteria"** refers to a large group of single-celled microorganisms that can thrive in diverse environments.
 
• The term "bacteria" is plural; the singular form is** "bacterium."**

Therefore, the **corrected sentence **should be:* "Bacteria are single-celled organisms that can reproduce on their own."*
